storeListing.title: Career Pilot: AI Career Guide
storeListing.shortDescription: Personalized career roadmaps, PDF note summaries, ATS resume tools & AI tutoring
storeListing.fullDescription:
Take full control of your future with Career Pilot — the AI-powered learning and career acceleration platform designed for students, job seekers, and career changers.

NAVIGATE YOUR CAREER WITH INTELLIGENCE
• Smart Career Discovery: Complete intuitive assessments of your interests, goals, subjects, and skills. Our AI analyzes your unique strengths to recommend matched career trajectories.
• Stage-Wise Roadmaps: Follow structured learning roadmaps partitioned into Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced stages with concrete milestones.
• Filtered Course Recommendations: Access vetted free and top-rated paid courses directly linked to your active learning objectives.

AI STUDY COMPANION & TUTORING
• PDF Syllabus & Note Summarization: Upload academic syllabi, lecture notes, or textbooks (up to 10 MB). Get structured summaries, chapter breakdowns, and instant review insights.
• Practice Quizzes & Flashcards: Automatically generate multiple-choice quizzes and interactive flashcards from your uploaded documents.
• 24/7 Contextual AI Tutor: Have natural conversations with an AI study tutor that understands your selected course materials and learning stage.

CAREER ACCELERATION & TOOLS
• ATS Resume Builder & Analyzer: Craft clean, structured resumes, run instant ATS compatibility audits with keyword analysis, and export professional multi-page PDFs.
• Job Application Tracker: Monitor opportunities across Saved, Applied, Screening, Interview, and Offer stages with custom note tracking.
• Hackathons & Team Finder: Discover upcoming developer hackathons and find collaborators with real contact channels.
• Tech News Feed: Stay updated with curated headlines in AI, tech startups, and hiring trends.
• Focus Study Timer: Stay productive with customizable pomodoro focus intervals and device-local study streak tracking.

PRIVACY & SECURITY FIRST
• 100% Student Data Ownership: Your notes, goals, and resumes belong exclusively to you.
• Hardware-Backed Security: Native session credentials are protected inside Android Keystore via SecureStore.
• Encrypted in Transit: All data is transmitted over secure HTTPS/TLS.
• Self-Service Account Deletion: Delete your account and all associated cloud data at any time directly in-app or via our web portal.

dataSafety.dataShared: No user data is shared with third parties or advertisers.
